name: attributes
task: (c) product text -> dimensions (cm), capacity (L), weight (kg), wheels, expandable
recordedFrom: body_html of real products in the 2026-10-30 /products.json pages (CLD p1/p13, Delsey p1), tags stripped, first 2,500 characters; deterministic sample (sha1)

labelRules.dimsCm: the three cm values the text states (first value of a range); inches only -> x2.54; null if none; compared sorted, +-1 cm
labelRules.capacityL: litres stated in the title or text; +-1 L
labelRules.wheels: wheel positions: 2 (two-wheeled/upright) or 4 (spinner, incl. double/dual spinner); null when the count isn't stated
labelRules.expandable: true when the bag itself is stated to expand; null otherwise (never false: absence isn't evidence)
